summary: Re-tested brute-force fix in /api/auth/login. The fix in /app/backend/routers/auth.py (reading X-Forwarded-For first IP, falling back to client.host) is correct. Updated TestZBruteForce::test_rate_limit_429 to send a stable X-Forwarded-For header across the 6 attempts, and added 2 new tests (lockout persistence + valid admin login sanity). Ran the FULL suite — 44/44 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: XFF parsing is correct (first IP, stripped). Consider trusting only when behind a known proxy in production to prevent spoofed XFF bypass — currently any client can spoof XFF and rotate IPs to evade the throttle. For this MVP/preview env it's acceptable.
Brute-force throttle is in-memory only — will not persist across pod restarts and is per-instance (not cluster-wide). Acceptable for MVP; flag for production hardening (Redis-backed).
Throttle key is (ip:email). A wide attacker could distribute attempts across many emails from one IP and never hit the cap. Consider an additional per-IP global counter.
seed_data_creation: None. Throwaway emails (throwaway_<hex>@nope.com, lockout_<hex>@nope.com) used per test; no DB pollution since users don't exist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brute-force fix validated. TestZBruteForce now has 3 tests: (1) 5x401 then 429 with stable XFF, (2) lockout persists after 429 with correct password, (3) valid admin login still works under XFF-based throttling. Throttle is in-memory — any restart of backend wipes _attempts. If retesting, use fresh throwaway emails and fresh XFF IPs to avoid carrying over throttle state. Full 44-test suite is green.
rca of the issue: Previous failure (iteration 1) was caused by /api/auth/login using request.client.host as the throttle key IP. In K8s, ingress source IP rotates per request, so each of the 6 login attempts had a different (ip:email) key and never hit the 5-attempt cap → no 429. Fix in routers/auth.py lines 44-45: xff = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for', ''); ip = xff.split(',')[0].strip() if xff else (request.client.host if request.client else 'unknown'). Reproduction in test: use requests.Session with sess.headers.update({'X-Forwarded-For': '<stable_ip>'}) and the 6th attempt returns 429 as expected. Mitigation deployed and verified.
